result.summary: The page is largely well composed, but the bottom navigation bar has a visually jarring horizontal divider that looks misplaced.

issues.description: A dark horizontal line/divider is rendered across the middle of the bottom tab bar, sitting between the Search and Orders icons and making the tab bar appear split or glitched.
issues.suggestion: Remove or reposition the divider so it sits at the top edge of the tab bar, or replace it with a proper active-tab indicator aligned with the selected icon.
